Hi Alyssa — thanks for the docs and heads-up.

Quick checklist from Redwood Finance/Procurement before we process the change:
- We need the bank change form plus a copy of a voided check or bank letter (your form looks good; voided check preferred).
- KYC hit: procurement will run a validation; expect a 1–2 business day turnaround.
- Important: any active PO issued to the old account will still pay to the original remittance unless we cancel and reissue the PO. Please advise if Orchid prefers us to cancel outstanding POs and reissue.
- Portal admin update (Tom): we can set Tom as the billing/portal owner once we confirm his email and complete a short identity verification step.

I copied Karthik to confirm whether a reissued PO will be required for POs currently in flight.

Next step from our side: finance will open a vendor-change ticket and reply once the validation completes. If you can send a voided check, that will speed things up.
